This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Fenn Booda]] was a member of this species.<ref name="EIR" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|white]] and black skin, with skinny [[Limb/Legends|limbs]], three-fingered hands, and long necks. They had tall heads and long faces, with [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] white<ref name="EIR" /> or yellow<ref name="J:AS" /> eyes featuring black, cross shaped pupils. Said eyes could change coloration between white<ref name="EIR" /> and yellow due to unknown means, and sometimes displayed a red glow.<ref name="J:AS" />

==Society and culture==
One member of this species, [[Fenn Booda]], served as the lead [[Warden/Legends|warden]] of the [[Desolation Alley]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]], located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]],<ref name="EIR" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC1">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'', which depicts Fenn Booda as the [[Warden/Legends|warden]] of the [[Desolation Alley]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]], must have taken place during this [[Standard year/Legends|year]] due to the game's appearances of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which correspond to the events of ''The Phantom Menace''.</ref> overseeing local [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] courses such as [[Vengeance (Oovo IV)|Vengeance]], [[Executioner (course)/Legends|Executioner]], and [[The Gauntlet (Podrace course)/Legends|The Gauntlet]].<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>
